about.title: Local machine work in the Gorge
paragraphs: B&M Excavation is based in Carson, Washington. We do pre-commercial thinning, residential and non-residential masticating, earthwork and utilities, and wildland firefighting.
Call Brandon at (541) 400-1471, Monday to Friday, 7am to 5pm.

estimate.title: Tell Brandon about your project.
estimate.text: Tell us about the property and the work you need, and Brandon will get back to you. Or call (541) 400-1471, Monday to Friday, 7am to 5pm.
estimate.thanks: Thanks! Brandon will get back to you soon.
